Interface Command

All Known Implementing Classes:
ChildCommand, ChildrenCommand, CloseCommand, DeleteCommand, ExitCommand, HelpCommand, NewchildCommand, OpenCommand, PrintCommand, SaveAsCommand, SaveCommand, SelectCommand, SetCommand, TextCommand, XPathCommand
public interface Command
Represents a command that can be executed within the XML parser application.

Implementations of this interface define specific actions to be performed based on user input, operating on an XMLDocument instance.
